visualCharacteristics.structure: heading over a row of App Store / Google Play badge image links on the left, QR code image on the right; QR hidden on mobile
visualCharacteristics.notes: Source div.sp07-app-promotion on /en/rewards/frequent-filler, inside a light-grey section (#e6e6e6). The block does not carry the background colour.

contentPattern: 1 row, 2 cells: [H2, paragraph(s) with store badge image links] | [QR code picture]; cell order is free, the QR cell is found by content
reuseGuidance: Use for app promotion bands (source .sp07-app-promotion / .app-promotion): heading, app store badges, optional QR code. Not for an image beside heading + text + CTA (use columns-media).
